item.title: Chronic Headaches Tied to Higher Rates of Depression and Anxiety
item.description: Adults with chronic headaches are nearly five times more likely to have clinical symptoms of depression, and at a more than seven times higher risk of clinical anxiety. The post Chronic Headaches Tied to Higher Rates of Depression and Anxiety appeared first on European Medical Journal.
